status: approved by delegation on 2026-09-13 (owner asked Claude to decide); change any time — the engine reads this file

phases.P1: Starts in month 1 (at most settings.maxExtraServicesStartingMonth1 non-strategic services, ranked by problem severity)
phases.P2: Starts in month 2 (remaining services, services not ready, or services whose rule says so)

recurringExecution: A recurring execution deliverable gets one instance in its start month, then one instance for each following month (month 2 = weeks 5–8, month 3 = weeks 9–12).

overrides.description: One build: weeks 3–7; dashboard week 8; optimisation report week 12. In P2: build weeks 6–10, dashboard week 11, optimisation week 12.
First optimisation report in week 12 only.
Final Media Asset Batch in the first execution week, before content or ads that use it.
Starts in P2 by default; execution no earlier than week 6; performance report at least 2 weeks after execution ends.
Implemented workflows no earlier than week 4, and after email execution has started when Email Marketing is also selected.
Campaign execution waits for client readiness (tracking installed + ad-account access). If readiness is 'not ready', the service starts in P2; if unknown, it is flagged at Gate 2.

hardRules: Week 1 contains only the 3 strategic deliverables, in order (Blueprint rule 08).
Preparation is compressed; execution takes most of the time (rule 09).
Monitoring and optimisation only after execution exists (rule 10).
Every dependency is respected; a schedule that breaks one is rejected.
Nothing is silently cut: anything that does not fit in 12 weeks is listed as 'continues after month 3' and flagged at Gate 2.

stageDefaults.P1: Week 1 only, in order: Product Portfolio Master Sheet → Brand Book Documentation → Marketing Strategy Map. Nothing else in week 1.
Weeks 3–4, then repeated each month if recurring
stageDefaults.P2: Weeks 6–8, then repeated each month if recurring
